description: Regression for the elite-prediction bug (2026-07-16). An interval REP session (8×800 with jog recoveries at ~4:50-5:00/mi rep pace) must NOT emit an equivalent_race_pace — reps are run faster than you can race, and equating the two invented a 15:00 5K that anchored the fitness predictor at a near-elite ~30:00 10K. For rep sessions, equivalent_race_pace MUST be null (only sustained continuous efforts, time trials, or declared races produce one). type must be 'interval'.
